name: ssh-exec

scripts.conformance: for c in ssh.hosts ssh.exec ssh.fetch; do case $c in ssh.hosts) A='{}';; ssh.exec) A='{"host":"example","argv":["uptime"]}';; ssh.fetch) A='{"host":"example","remotePath":"/etc/hostname","localPath":"hostname.txt"}';; esac; npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract $c --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --args "$A" || exit 1; done

description: CAK 插件：经本机 ssh（只走密钥、BatchMode）在远程主机跑命令 / 拉文件 / 列主机别名（ssh.exec@1 / ssh.fetch@1 / ssh.hosts@1）
